content:
If you missed yesterday's "Surprise and Shine" event and don't want to watch the entire video that's over an hour long, Apple's YouTube channel has you covered. Check out the event recap below right now.

Apple's short event recap shared

In addition to the iPhone Duo and Apple's first foldable iPhone, Apple also unveiled the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max yesterday, along with the Apple Watch Series 12 and Ultra 4, as well as the AirPods 5 with active noise cancellation.

The event lasted almost 1 hour and 20 minutes, staying true to Apple's signature style, with executives taking turns speaking to the camera, interspersed with promotional demos and product advertisements.

If you don't have that much time to watch it all, Apple has also released a breezy short recap, where a narrator uses rewind and fast-forward techniques to summarize the highlights of each announcement.

Apple has also separately uploaded the full presentation segment for each product, which you can watch all together below.
